answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a scarce, nonrefundable resource before it can influence decisions, then slash that bond when independent audits catch fabricated identities or coordinated abuse. A single operator can still create many accounts, but each one must lock up real value and risk losing it; splitting identities no longer makes influence free. Audits should rely on evidence, not names such as comet, willow, or ferrous, so unusual labels alone never trigger punishment.
